# I Can't Believe CRM

> Self-hosted !AI CRM for support, sales, WhatsApp operations and AI agents.

Key facts:
- Category: CRM / AI sales operating system / WhatsApp customer platform
- Brand: !AI, I Can't Believe It's AI
- Repository slug: icantbelievecrm
- Stack: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Supabase, WAHA, Docker
- License: MIT
